Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the first woman appointed to the U.S. Supreme Court as Ruth Bader Ginsburg. In reality, Sandra Day O'Connor was the first woman appointed (1981), while Ruth Bader Ginsburg was the second (1993). This fundamental factual error caused the entire subsequent search process to focus on the wrong individual, leading to an incorrect solution to the real-world problem.
